 Order
1] They are heard and perused the case diary.

2] This is the applicant's fifth bail application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ Section 439 of Cr.P.C. as he/she is implicated in connection with Crime No.45/2024 registered at Police Station Suvasara, District- Mandsaur (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(N), 365, 450 of the IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 11.03.2024.
Applicant's fourth bail application-M.Cr.C.No.50288/2024 was dismissed by this Court on 15.01.2025 with liberty to renew the prayer if the trial is not concluded within six months.
3] The allegation against the applicant is of abduction and rape.

4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that it has already been more than six months since the last rejection of the bail application, and till now, 08 witnesses have been examined and the ninth witness is not appearing in the trial court despite issuance of the arrest warrants.
Copy of the proceedings have also been filed on record.

It is further submitted that the prosecutrix and all other witnesses have already been examined in the trial court and there are material omissions and contradictions in their NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21054 2 MCRC-30781-2025 statements.
It is further submitted that the applicant is in jail since 11.03.2024, and the final conclusion of the trial is likely to take a Shyam Sundar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025

1 long time.
Thus, it is prayed that the application be allowed.
5] Counsel for the State/State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer.

6] Having considered the rival submissions, perusal of the case-diary, and taking note of the fact that the prosecutrix has already been examined and the MLC is silent and also considering the period of incarceration and the last witness is not appearing in the trial court despite issuance of the arrest warrants, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.
7] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
8] Accordingly, the application is allowed and disposed of.
C.c. as per rules.
